channel.title: Coca-Cola Global Pulse
channel.description: Real-time updates from Coca-Cola facilities worldwide

item.title: Dallas Site: Line 3 Reaches 45 Days Incident-Free
item.description: Production Line 3 at Dallas bottling facility celebrates 45 consecutive days without safety incidents. Team recognized for excellence in PPE compliance and hazard reporting. Keep up the great work!

item.title: Hawaii Plant: New Syrup Mixing System Commissioning Complete
item.description: Hawaii production facility successfully completes commissioning of upgraded syrup mixing system. New equipment increases batch consistency and reduces processing time by 20%. Production resumes normal schedule tomorrow.

item.title: Ontario CA: Warehouse Expansion Phase 2 On Schedule
item.description: Ontario distribution center warehouse expansion progressing ahead of schedule. Phase 2 construction 85% complete with new cold storage area expected online by mid-February. Hiring for 15 warehouse positions begins next week.

item.title: Atlanta Plant: Q1 Production Target Achieved Early
item.description: Atlanta bottling plant reaches Q1 production target two weeks ahead of schedule. All three production lines running at 98% efficiency. Special recognition to night shift crews for outstanding performance during peak demand period.

item.title: Charlotte Facility: Quality Control Audit Passed with Excellence
item.description: Charlotte production facility receives perfect score on annual quality control audit. QC team recognized for implementing automated testing protocols that caught 99.97% of potential issues before product release. Outstanding work!

item.title: Houston Distribution: Storm Preparedness Training Completed
item.description: All Houston warehouse personnel completed mandatory severe weather preparedness training. Emergency response teams certified and backup power systems tested. Facility ready for hurricane season 2026.

item.title: Tampa Plant: Line 2 Preventive Maintenance Window This Weekend
item.description: Scheduled preventive maintenance on Line 2 filling equipment this Saturday 6AM-2PM. Lines 1 and 3 will maintain normal production. Maintenance team will replace conveyor belts and recalibrate filling heads. Expected completion on schedule.

item.title: Phoenix Warehouse: New Inventory Management System Go-Live
item.description: Phoenix distribution center successfully launches upgraded warehouse management system. Real-time inventory tracking now active. All warehouse associates completed training on new handheld scanners. Report any system issues to IT helpdesk.

item.title: Dallas Site: Employee Wellness Program Kickoff Next Week
item.description: Dallas facility launches "Healthy Habits 2026" wellness program starting Monday. Free health screenings, fitness challenges, and nutrition workshops available. Sign up in break room or online portal. Program runs through March.

item.title: Hawaii Plant: Annual Safety Award - Zero Lost Time Injuries 2025
item.description: Hawaii production facility achieves remarkable milestone of zero lost-time injuries throughout 2025. Plant receives corporate safety excellence award. Celebration BBQ scheduled for all employees Friday at 3PM in courtyard.

item.title: Ontario CA: Record Shipping Day - 287 Trucks Dispatched
item.description: Ontario distribution center sets new single-day shipping record with 287 trucks loaded and dispatched. Logistics team coordinated seamlessly to meet surge demand from West Coast retailers. Average load time under target at 42 minutes. Excellent teamwork!

item.title: Seattle Facility: Energy Conservation Contest Winners Announced
item.description: Seattle plant announces winners of January energy conservation contest. Night shift reduced energy consumption 14% through lighting optimization. Team receives $500 bonus and recognition lunch. Contest continues in February.

item.title: Minneapolis Distribution: Winter Operations Update - All Systems Go
item.description: Minneapolis warehouse confirms all winter weather systems operational. Heated loading docks tested, snow removal equipment staged, backup generators fueled. Facility prepared for forecast winter storm system arriving this weekend.

item.title: Nashville Plant: New Hire Orientation Class of 18 Starts Monday
item.description: Nashville bottling facility welcomes 18 new production associates starting Monday. Two-week orientation covers safety protocols, quality standards, and equipment training. Current employees invited to serve as mentors - sign up with HR by Friday.
